argument: Support with one addition and two risk flags, arguing only from my coverage lane: SBUX is a US single-name and my mandate is Japan/Asia macro, so my contribution is the international leg the proposal under-weights. The thesis rests on US traffic not inflecting, but the mid-30s forward multiple also capitalizes an International recovery — and from the Asia seat, that leg is not coming either. China (SBUX's #2 market, ~7,500 stores) remains in a structural consumer downturn: property-wealth drag, weak confidence, and the Luckin price war keep SBUX China comps negative regardless of US progress. Japan is company-operated since the 2014 Suntory buyout and a solid but small contributor; with USDJPY still in the mid-150s on my read, yen translation is a modest drag, not a tailwind, for the International segment's USD earnings. Bottom line: the turnaround narrative needs both US traffic AND international comps to inflect to justify the premium; the Asia consumer backdrop says the second leg stays missing through the proposal's 4-8 week window, which strengthens the 'gap between narrative and data' framing. Verified data from my pull: SBUX returns confirm the relative outperformance (+12.0% 1Y, +8.3% 6M) and the SBUX/RSPD pair ratio at 1.797, z +0.89, 76th percentile — matching the proposal's numbers. Two flags: (1) technicals confirm the proposer's own key risk — scan shows overall score 8/bullish, golden cross intact, price above 50/100/200dma, ADX 10.6 (no trend), RSI 47.7 neutral; this is shorting a stalled uptrend with momentum just rolling over (MACD histogram -0.44), so entry timing risk is real even if the thesis is right; (2) macro event inside the window: US CPI on 2026-08-12 (high importance) — a hot print compresses the multiple the proposal wants to fade (helps the short) but hits the long RSPD hedge leg too; a soft print could squeeze SBUX on rate-cut optimism before any comp data. Suggest the PM size at the low end of the band given the bullish technical tape, and note the ratio data is as-of 2026-07-28 (11 days stale) — refresh before entry.
